reference: Relationship P0152/P0184/P0185: native version restoration, current authority, protected definitions and execution references.
status: Native playbook restoration and source interface locally validated; no current-source Chrome or production/external acceptance and no C-G closure.
implementation: POST playbooks/:id/restore accepts exact current/prior integer versions and a bounded reason, selects the same-account stored definition and creates the next version through the EXISTING update_playbook! writer. Caller definitions are ignored.
Fresh locked authority refreshes the SAME authenticated account/user/member in this repository's thread-local Current module; no impersonation or new source access grant.

Restoration always reviews Flow references, even when steps equal the current book. It cannot silently reuse an old pin after the published Flow changes. Existing ordinary edit behavior, native validation, current contact/conversation/unit permissions and origin checks remain in the writer.

Native model validations, old version rows, snapshots and historical execution records remain unchanged. Incomplete legacy definitions are explicitly blocked rather than merged with unrelated current fields.

Existing book-history payload now has visible review controls. Fresh server reads precede comparison; exact ID/current+1/source receipt and native readback precede saved feedback. Role/account change and conflict/unknown commit result cannot confirm or auto-retry old writes.

Reuse native PlaybookDesignPreview with simulationOnly/readOnlyDefinition for restoration. The run guard cannot execute even when a simulated approval token is returned; historical references cannot be edited/repinned inside this preview. Normal preview behavior remains covered by existing tests.

Show enabled state, conditions, step titles/types/timing and saved versions in native responsive themed dialogs. Added missing native complex-rule labels and readable structured history instead of object-placeholder text.

native_evidence.coverage: Actual API create/edit/edit/restore; immutable original definitions and a full synthetic historical execution record; conflict/idempotent retry; caller injection ignored; foreign tenant/native configure denial; malformed versions/reason; incomplete legacy; stale published Flow pin and rollback with no runs/messages/success audit.

same-flow-baseline07 reproduced a real bug: steps unchanged from the current book skipped the full Flow review and incorrectly returned200 after publication changed. Added review_definition to the reused native writer for restoration only.
